Advertisement for Casualty Medical Officers
Monday, 14 August 2017
6249 Hits
Medical Superintendent, Kasturba Hospital Sevagram invites applications for the post of
Casualty Medical Officer
. Candidates along with complete biodata and necessary academic experience certificates/testimonials may come for walk-in interviews any day between 10 am - 3 pm (Monday-Friday).
No of posts - 4
Qualification: MBBS degree with one year of internship
Pay Scale: (15,600 - 39,100 + GP of 5,400/month). House Rent Allowance (HRA) and Non-Practicing Allowance (NPA) shall be paid, as per the service rules of the Institute.
For more details please contact:
Phone 07152-284341 to 384355 (Ext 201)
Contact Person: Mr G Deo (Office Superintendent)
Mobile: +91-9403784155
Email:
aohospital@mgims.ac.in
Website: ww.mgims.ac.in
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
